concerns.text: The implementation hardcodes specific target UUIDs ('85feb4bc-7a85-45bf-a637-476d48d00d6a' and '68c31f3d-be90-4949-b5df-b741cd52c4ef') directly within the Java code logic, which makes them inflexible and difficult to manage without redeploying code.

Retrieving all ready/queued tasks via findByStatus(TaskStatus.READY) and filtering them in memory for stuck pipeline tasks can lead to memory overhead and performance degradation as the tasks database table grows.
